space.expression: Depends on the selected lattice reduction and enumeration implementation.

notes: Explicit optimization of the reduction/enumeration balance. The source observes that Lindner–Peikert’s example choices were not necessarily optimal. This records a cost model, not a new universal exponent.

extra.parameters: Fix n,q,m, Gaussian width αq, target success ε, per-node cost and reduced-basis profile.
extra.noise: Gaussian width αq; discrete/continuous approximation as in the decoding analysis.
extra.samples: Survey allows unlimited samples; a finite deployment must enforce its actual m cap.
extra.objective: Recover the secret by BDD decoding.
extra.model: Minimize total preprocessing plus enumeration over δ₀ and branch counts d.
extra.assumptions: Basis-profile model (typically GSA) and Gaussian-coordinate decoding probabilities.

evidence.locator: §5.4, pp. 187–189, equation defining t_dec(ε) and discussion of optimizing Lindner–Peikert
evidence.sourceVersion: Journal of Mathematical Cryptology 9(3), published 2 October 2015
